name: Igarashi Haru
source:
A 1st year student in "The Ignored Stones" class.

Reticent and curt, you can't tell what he's thinking. However, on the occasion that Haru does open his mouth, he proves to be quite sharp-tongued. His "medieval" appearance coupled with his low social standing makes him a target of bullying- he is constantly injured. He hardly ever interacts with others, but is often seen with Toya, as Toya comes and talks to him.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/28/zettai-kaikyuu-gakuen-eden-with-roses-and-phantasm/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
